symptom: ako/mxcli#2014 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1774): `check --references` on a script with a reference error in statement A and a flow change exec refuses (MDL-V1-REBUILD, a decision added in a loop body) in statement B reported only A; B showed up after A was fixed, or as an exec that ran far and rolled back. The reporter also saw '0 errors' in the summary on 0.29.0.
cause: runCheckFileAgainst returned finish(1) right after printing the reference errors, before the project tier that runs CheckFlowVerdictsReport. The summary half was already fixed by ako/mxcli#1928.
file: cmd/mxcli/cmd_check.go (on reference errors, still run executor.ApplyV1Policy(exec.CheckFlowVerdictsReport(prog).Violations, v1) and report them before failing)
insight: Only the verdicts are run after a reference error, not the whole project tier: the expression-type and member checks mostly restate an unresolved name as type errors, which is noise; the verdicts are what exec would refuse regardless. Check whether half of a report is already fixed on main before re-fixing it (#1928 covered the summary count).
